name: RimNotes
body: That second release is clean. The trail makes the ball flight much easier to follow.

name: Sam
body: I’d keep another second before the first shot. Nice to see the setup as well as the finish.

name: Jules
body: Is the tracer automatic, or do you mark the ball positions yourself?

name: BaselineView
body: The short, fading trail works well here. I can still see the actual ball.

name: Maya
body: Agreed. A little more of the pass into that shot would make the clip feel more complete.
